node_context:
Seven classical amygdala cell types under investigation:
- basal_amygdala_fear_neuron: Glutamatergic principal neuron in basal amygdala (BA/BLA), functionally defined by CS+ activation during Pavlovian fear conditioning; non-overlapping population with extinction neurons; no distinct molecular markers yet identified.
- basal_amygdala_extinction_neuron: Glutamatergic principal neuron in basal amygdala activated after repeated CS+/unreinforced extinction trials; markers: Ntsr2, Dkk3, Rspo2, Wnt7a, Thy1; receives reciprocal mPFC input.
- bla_npy_neurogliaform_cell: GABAergic interneuron in BLA with neurogliaform morphology; defining marker: NPY (Npy, protein and transcript); from Vereczki et al. 2021.
- bla_calbindin_dendrite_targeting_interneuron: GABAergic interneuron in BLA; marker: Calb1 (calbindin); negative for Pvalb; targets dendrites of principal neurons.
- cea_large_aspiny_neuron: GABAergic neuron in central amygdala (CeA); large soma, aspiny dendrites; CeA is a striatum-like structure with predominantly GABAergic projection neurons.
- cea_small_aspiny_neuron: GABAergic neuron in central amygdala (CeA); small soma, aspiny dendrites; sister morphological class to large aspiny.
- paralaminar_immature_neuron: Immature excitatory neuron in paralaminar nucleus / ventral amygdala; marker: Dcx (doublecortin); represents late-maturing neurons that may mature post-natally through adolescence.
